title: chemoqbit: quantum chemistry of 5-fluorouracil proton transfer on an FPGA state-vector simulator
description: Code, results and tests for an end-to-end study of the lactam-lactim proton shift of 5-fluorouracil and formamide on qubits: PySCF active spaces, UCCSD and ADAPT-VQE with adjoint gradients, a 32-bit instruction set and bit-accurate 18-bit fixed-point emulation for the qsim-pynq FPGA simulator (PYNQ-Z2), composite CCSD(T) corrections and Eckart tunnelling. Includes a FastAPI module for an oncology research platform. Educational; not for clinical use.
